theme.name: Theme
theme.description: The visual theme of the toaster.

position.name: Position
position.description: The position of the toaster on the screen.

richColors.name: Rich Colors
richColors.description: When true, uses richer colors for toast variants.

expand.name: Expand
expand.description: When true, toasts are expanded by default.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The default duration in milliseconds for each toast.

visibleToasts.name: Visible Toasts
visibleToasts.description: The maximum number of toasts that are visible at once.

closeButton.name: Close Button
closeButton.description: When true, adds a close button to each toast.

invert.name: Invert
invert.description: Dark toasts in light mode and vice versa.

hotkey.name: Hotkey
hotkey.description: Keyboard shortcut to focus the toast area.

pauseWhenPageIsHidden.name: Pause When Page Is Hidden
pauseWhenPageIsHidden.description: When true, toasts pause their timers when the page is hidden.
